text:
ana: Heads-up: RFC landed for adding a first-class metadata envelope (rw_meta) to responses. concern: many customers expect the top-level "output" shape. we need a compatibility plan so we don't break parser libs.

ben: Agreed. Proposal: introduce envelope shape as v2 responses and keep v1 behaviour by default. Add an Accept header to opt into v2: Accept: application/redwood.v2+json. server provides a very small shim that can convert v2->v1 for clients that don't ask for v2.

zhao: How will the shim be selected? header only? query param? tenant flag?\ana: Priority order: 1) Accept header -> v2 path; 2) tenant opt-in flag -> treat as v2 for that tenant; 3) if neither, serve v1. no UA sniffing.

marta: For SDKs we should set the Accept header automatically when upgrading major version. also publish a compat shim package for self-hosters.

ben: Telemetry plan: emit event "envelope.sent" vs "envelope.fallback" with tags {tenant, route, model}. sample 100% for v2, 2% for v1 fallbacks.

zhao: Implementation notes: put shim in response-serializer layer right after token-join. when shim active, translate {rw_meta, output} -> legacy {output, metadata_*} shape. preserve ordering and types. keep translation deterministic.\ana: Perf: extra copy for translation but should be negligible for small meta. add counters: envelope.translate.ms and envelope.size.delta.bytes.\marta: Rollout flags: runtime.config.envelope = off|opt-in|force. default opt-in. force used only when we flip tenants to v2 globally.

ben: Rollout steps: 1) add Accept header handling + opt-in flag behind off; 2) land shim and telemetry in staging; 3) opt-in internal tenants and SDK beta (10%); 4) increase to 30/60/100% opt-in; 5) after 8 weeks and no regressions, enable force for tenants that opt-in; 6) publish deprecation timeline for old plain shape (12 months).

zhao: Rollback triggers: any tenant with >2x error.rate or +25% p95 latency or increase in model-side tokenization errors gets auto-switched to legacy shape and alerted. add a script to flip tenant flag quickly.\marta: SDK compatibility: we'll ship redwood-js@next setting Accept and a small polyfill for Node consumers that can't parse envelope. also contact major 3rd-party SDK vendors with a migration patch.\ana: Docs snippet:
```
# request opting into envelope v2
curl -H "Accept: application/redwood.v2+json" -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate

# fallback: force legacy shape via query param for testing
curl "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?format=legacy" -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY"
```

ben: Security review: rw_meta must not contain sensitive PII by default. add a review step and a checklist to the PR.

zhao: Ops: cache tenant opt-in flags in-memory for 12h and invalidate on change. keep flags per-tenant/route. add a small metrics exporter for opt-in coverage.

ci-bot: CI for feature/envelope -> staging: build 5032; tests: 1212 passed, 3 flaky ignored. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Monitoring: created dashboards "envelope.fallback_rate", "envelope.translate_latency" and alert "envelope.rollback_trigger" (p95 > 1s or error_rate spike).\marta: Testing: add golden-output diffs for v1 and v2 shapes and a fuzz test that injects extra rw_meta keys to ensure shim drops unknown fields in legacy mode.\ana: One more constraint: shim must be purely shape conversion. no enrichment, no behavioral semantics change. explicit contract: if field absent in legacy, drop it; if type mismatch, coerce with documented rules.\ben: Owners: ana (spec + docs), zhao (runtime + flags), marta (SDK + vendor outreach).\ana: Let's meet Thu 9am to review staging metrics after the shim lands. thanks. :v:
